title: Graph zone type with real topology
description: Promote graph zone from Set (unordered bag) to real topology. Add nodes (named positions), edges (pairs of node names), node_properties. Runtime: RuntimeZone::Graph with adjacency list and occupants. Movement: step to adjacent node, hop over occupied neighbor. No direction vectors — movement constrained by neighbor list or CEL. Unblocks Risk, Pandemic, Scotland Yard, and other territory/network games.
close_reason: Graph zone fully implemented: schema, Rust RuntimeZone::Graph, Python GraphZone, 23 tests. Unblocks 9 territory/network games.
